name.zh: 莉夏决斗与石像鬼袭击

periods.summary: Lisha duels Lux using Tiamat and nearly overwhelms his Wyvern, but a Gargoyle Abyss interrupts. Lux protects the audience and coordinates with Lisha so Seven Dragon Heads destroys the Abyss.
periods.cause: Lisha tests Lux's worth and wants to punish him for seeing her secret; the Gargoyle appears unexpectedly from outside academy defenses.
periods.process: Lisha uses Air Fortress, Seven Dragon Heads, and Heaven Voice; Lux endures defensively; when the Gargoyle attacks, Lux diverts its shots, baits it into an opening, and signals Lisha to fire.
periods.outcome: The Gargoyle is destroyed, Lux is injured, and Lisha begins trusting him.
periods.aftermath: Lisha reveals her hidden imperial brand to Lux and insists he remain at the academy as a student.
periods.significance: Shows Lux's defensive mastery, Lisha's Divine Drag-Ride power, and the first sign of Abyss manipulation.
